description:
A powerful app to customize & extend Google Calendar.


### Highlights
• **Reworked settings** – regrouped into clearer sections with many new options, and translated into all of PowCal's languages
• **Smarter spam filter** – catches invitations luring you to a site, trusts senders marked "Not spam", and can leave spam on the calendar
• **Declined invitations** – a new inbox tab lists invitations you declined, so you can still accept them
• **Calls in their apps** – Zoom and Microsoft Teams calls open straight in their desktop apps where installed, unless you turn it off

### Also in this release

#### Added
• A "Display size" setting to scale the whole interface to 90–150% instead of fitting it to the window
• A "Minimum display duration" setting to draw events as short as 5 or 10 minutes, below Google Calendar's 15
• A setting to show the calendar's color stripe on events with their own color
• A setting to show duplicate events in full instead of shrinking or dimming the extra copies
• Settings to turn off auto-fill from similar events and for travel events
• A setting to check spelling while typing, with suggestions on right-click
• A setting to hide the number of unseen invitations on the Dock or taskbar icon
• <kbd>Cmd</kbd>/<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>,</kbd> opens Settings, as in other apps
• A right-click menu to open or copy links, copy email addresses, and cut, copy or paste text
• Hovering a link shows its full URL in a status bar
• Join buttons for Webex, Whereby and Jitsi Meet calls, Zoom X and newer Microsoft Teams links
• Opening a `webcal://` link subscribes to its calendar, keeping it up to date, instead of importing it once

#### Improved
• Smarter categorization – invitations nothing else matches count as meetings, and ambiguous words misfire less
• The "Apply rule changes?" preview lists every change an AI agent made, with the affected events as they'll look
• Working location suggestions name the right city more often
• The inbox shows invitation times in your time zone, like the calendar
• Links to Google apps like Docs or Gmail open in your browser with the right account
• PowCal works better by keyboard and screen reader throughout
• Various visual refinements

#### Fixed
• Answering a recurring invitation from the inbox or a desktop notification keeps dates you answered separately
• Importing several calendar files at once no longer drops their time zones, which could shift event times
• Back-to-back events now sit evenly 1px apart, at every zoom level
• The all-day row resizes correctly after the "Reduce height of all-day and month view events" setting changes
• Shrinking duplicate events also works with another event between them, and spares the one you're attending
• Events with just you and a booked room no longer show the guest badge
• Appointment schedule bookings get category icons and count in Time Insights
• Responses, spam reports and other changes PowCal makes right after startup show at once, not minutes later
• Opening an invitation marked as spam no longer takes it out of the "Spam" tab
• Desktop notifications for invitations and cancellations show times in your time zone, not the organizer's
• Times PowCal shows match Google Calendar's where time zone rules recently changed, as in British Columbia
• The event creation dialog no longer jumps when auto-fill switches its calendar
• After auto-fill picks a color, keyboard focus no longer jumps to the color dropdown
• With the end lock on, picking a start date from the date picker keeps the end date fixed
• "Adjust to location's time zone?" no longer skips some time zones, or asks where the clock is the same
• <kbd>Cmd</kbd>/<kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Z</kbd> undoes calendar changes even with Google Calendar's keyboard shortcuts turned off
• Importing a calendar file from a link no longer gets stuck, and a failed download now shows an error
• Our Safari extension now hands Google Calendar links to PowCal, and the setup menu takes you to enable it
• Email addresses, phone numbers and links to other apps in event descriptions now open their app
• The join button no longer opens a tracking link instead of the call, or hides room names in the location
• Settings changed while offline sync as soon as you're back online

#### Removed
• The "Details Overlay" settings, each now fixed at its default
